title: Old Book Smell Is The Book Falling Apart
hook: The smell you love is the object dying, slowly, in front of you.

cast.note: The narration names Bill directly at the payoff. Mina is the conservator. Mochi smells the book too and is unimpressed by it.

scenes.note: Bill has his face in a book at frame 0, blissful. The reveal turns the bliss into decay.

beats.action: Bill with his nose buried in an open old book, eyes closed, deeply content; scent curls rise
the scent curls thicken; a single page corner flakes away and drifts down
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the scent curls draw upward in warm gold
the curls turn from gold to sickly green and the book's edges visibly crumble; Bill's eyes snap open

scenes.note: Four materials named, four labelled and aged in turn. Rhythmic — one per keyword.

beats.action: cutaway of the book's spine and pages, exploded slightly apart
the page stack labels PAPER and yellows
the ink labels and fades brown
the spine glue labels and cracks
the stitching labels and frays
small molecule marks lift off every labelled part and drift upward

scenes.note: Four smells, four icons. Each pops on its own word — this is the densest scene in the episode.

beats.action: the molecule marks rise past the labelled layers, gathering into a cloud
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: a grass blade icon pops in on a green scent curl
a dusty cloud icon pops in on a grey curl
an almond icon pops in on a tan curl
a vanilla pod icon pops in on a warm cream curl; the four hang together

scenes.note: The one named compound. Mina supplies it. Keep the molecule simple and readable, not accurate chemistry.

beats.action: the three dimmed scent icons drift quietly behind the vanillin one
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the three other scent icons dim; the vanilla one enlarges and labels VANILLIN
Mina steps in and points at it; a small sweet-note flourish

scenes.note: The smell becomes data. Scent curls get captured and turned into a readout.

beats.action: cut to a plain lab bench; the book sits under a collection funnel
the readout needle settles and holds; the jar clouds slightly
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: scent curls are drawn up the funnel into a jar
the jar feeds a readout showing a condition score; Mina reads it and nods

scenes.note: Bill is named in the narration. Return to the exact opening framing so the reframe lands.

beats.action: dust drifts down through the shelf light behind Bill
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: Mochi sits down beside the book and stares at it, deciding
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: back to the opening shot: Bill's face back in the book
beats.sync: keyword: Bill — named in the narration

beats.action: a 100 YEARS card stamps on the cover; dust puffs off it
Bill goes blissful again, unbothered by everything he just learned
the molecule marks drift past at absurdly slow speed; Mochi sniffs the book once and walks away judging him; hard cut
beats.sync: keyword: extremely slow motion — final beat
